name: avatar
useFor: Use Avatar for people and agents beside their names (thread owners, reviewers, seats). Always give AvatarFallback two initials. Use AvatarGroup for the people on a thread, with AvatarGroupCount for the rest. Color the AvatarBadge dot with a status class (bg-success for running).
constraints: Rings or shadows around a single avatar
source: The Hoplite website's .trust__avatar (40px hexagon) and .chat__people, with the point-up hexagon of its marks (ds-hex-mark)

title: Avatar
description: A 40px hexagon holding a photo, or Kode Mono initials on the hover wash; point-up by default or the trust strip's cut box. 32px and 48px sizes, a round status dot, and overlapping groups cut out of the ground.
